lead: `cargo test --lib -p nvs-cli <name>` cannot run one of that crate's cases: it has no library target.
body: The cases live in the `nvs` binary, so the answer is `no library targets found in package` and not a missing test. Run `cargo test --bin nvs <name>` — no `-p`, which is what `AGENTS.md` asks for anyway, and the bin name is unique across the workspace.
